2.0 · automatic conversion of split bundles to one signed APK, conversion of installed apps, deep security scan and a fast share manager

Version 2.0: APKS, XAPK and APKM bundles are merged into one signed APK automatically before install (can be turned off), and any installed split app can be converted to an APK from its menu. Stable 1.0: installs APK, APKS, XAPK and APKM through the official system installer with integrity, signature, CPU and space checks. A five-layer deep security scan runs before every install: signature (algorithm, key size, validity, Janus), archive integrity (Master Key, Zip Slip), manifest and exposed components, task hijacking and name spoofing, hidden payloads and packers, and DEX code scanning (mining, remote control, leak channels, embedded secrets, weak crypto). Each finding has a risk level and explanation, plus SHA-256 checking, a block list, trusted signers and an optional fingerprint lock. Silent installs without consent are not available to any normal app, so the system may ask you to confirm.

1. Tap "Copy the script code" on the previous screen.
2. Open script.google.com in the browser with "Desktop site" on, sign in, and create a new project.
3. Delete the existing code and paste the copied code.
4. Change the text inside the quotes on the first line (SECRET) to a long secret of your choice, at least 12 characters.
5. Save, pick the function setup, tap Run and grant the permissions (on the "unverified" screen choose Advanced, then Continue).
6. Tap Deploy, then New deployment, then type "Web app": Execute as Me, Who has access Anyone. Copy the address.
7. Paste the address and the secret in the two fields below.
